claims.claim: With identical persistent relation representation, direct indexed lookup produces the same observed relation semantics as object-language traversal while using substantially fewer measured online transitions/accesses in the tested fixture.
claims.scope: one five-entry mapping; five online queries; CEK-style interpreter

claims.claim: Under the S1 contract, relation lookup is derivable from the same stored mapping using state read, generic iteration, comparison, branching, and object-language recursion.
claims.scope: experimental interpreter and finite mapping fixture
limits: does not establish that the canonical Machine substrate has S1

claims.claim: The canonical Machine substrate has not yet been shown to implement the experimental S1 or S2 contract.
claims.next_discriminating_test: Reconcile the experimental interpreter with the actual canonical interpreter source and repeat the minimal pair there.
